DECL Shao.OQ3.imaginary_exponential_taylor_remainder_bound
TYPE ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
  ‖Complex.exp (↑t * Complex.I) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (↑t * Complex.I) ^ j / ↑j.factorial‖ ≤
    (Real.exp 1 + ↑m + 1) * |t| ^ m
AXIOMS [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
KIND theorem
